title: Drive the telemetry retirement test's client deadline with the scripted clock
outcome: The telemetry case in src/tests/federation_rpc.rs (around :69) no longer waits for the real 2 s client deadline. A scripted client clock is advanced once the held handler has signalled entry, so the protocol expiry and the retirement-record assertions are both driven by logical time. The test keeps its observable assertions.
acceptance: Drive the telemetry retirement test's client deadline with the scripted clock is done
